verify.stdout:
governor:      performance  want performance
  no_turbo:      1            want 1
  SMT:           off          want off
  online CPUs:   0-3          want 0-3
  AllowedCPUs:   0-1          want 0-1
  MemoryMax:     3221225472   want 3221225472
  AC power:      1            want 1
  throttles:     core=0 pkg=0
  ora_* affinity: (db down)    want 0-1
  freq now:      1800 1800 1799 1801 
  engines:       measuring oracle
    postgresql:  inactive     want inactive
    mysql:       inactive     want inactive
    commercial_a:       inactive     want inactive

cmd: for p in $(pgrep -u oracle); do awk '/Cpus_allowed_list/{print $2}' /proc/$p/status; done | sort | uniq -c
